headline: Bitcoin Exchange Reserves Rise By 13,962 Coins To 1,261,641, Led By Binance
narrative: Bitcoin held across the eight largest exchanges rose to 1,261,641 coins, 13,962 coins above the prior daily print of 1,247,679. Binance holdings rose by 11,437 coins to 650,596 from 639,159, while OKX rose by 1,203 coins to 148,065 and Bitfinex rose by 909 coins to 158,396. The pipe counts bitcoin coins at those venues, so the higher print means more bitcoin arrived on the exchanges than left since the prior daily count.
author: jordan
